items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The next brother was Fletcher. You don't have Fletcher.

ctx.x: Would you name the brothers for me?

Yes, I remember them. My oldest brother was named Charles - I think you have Charles. The next brother was Fletcher. You don't have Fletcher. Garnett. Walter. Marion. Robert. Then the twins, Jay C. and C. B. How many do you have there?
